name: Pulse
description: Pulse turns complex documents (PDFs, scans, spreadsheets, Office files) into clean markdown, tables and structured JSON with AI-powered extraction.

events.d: Extract structured JSON from a saved extraction or split using a schema.
Find which pages of a saved extraction belong to each topic you define.
Extract text, markdown, tables and layout from a document URL.
Pull structured tables from a saved extraction, with optional cross-page merging.
Get the status and result of an asynchronous Pulse job.
Cancel a pending or processing asynchronous Pulse job.
Get credit status and document, page and credit usage for a date range.
